handoff.text:
Decision needed: release/1.0.0 → main conflicts

The merge conflicts, so nothing was created. Conflicted files:
  - app/models/seat.rb
  - config/settings.yml

main mirrors production and holds changes release/1.0.0 never received. Do not resolve this or merge main into release/1.0.0: that would deploy it to the release servers without a new release candidate. A human chooses one option:
  1. Option 1, take main's changes into a new candidate (usually right): Run create_release_candidate with releaseType patch, merge origin/main into the new release branch, promote it with release_version, have Ops deploy it to every production host, then downmerge that release into main, which is clean by then.
  2. Option 2, leave them out of release/1.0.0: cut release-1.0.0-into-main-<unix-timestamp> off origin/main, merge origin/release/1.0.0 into it, resolve app/models/seat.rb, config/settings.yml, and open a pull request into main titled "Release 1.0.0 to main". Say in it that main will then differ from what production runs.

The full procedure is docs/manual-downmerge.md in the versioner repository (https://github.com/officespacesoftware/versioner/blob/master/docs/manual-downmerge.md).
